meta.title: ci: optimize workflow timeouts based on timing analysis
meta.body_summary: Reduce GitHub Actions workflow timeouts (playwright.yml, test_cli.yaml) based on historical run duration analysis to save CI minutes while preserving sufficient buffers.

perf_labels.notes: Devin analyzed historical run times and reduced CI timeouts; merged quickly after maintainer approval with no benchmarking beyond the PR narrative.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 16 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, low-risk performance PR (CI configuration) and its quick merge is consistent with that profile.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer approved with empty body; no explicit concerns were raised in the review.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce workflow timeouts based on historical run times to save CI minutes while maintaining sufficient buffers.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple configuration change in CI workflows requiring historical data analysis and arithmetic; within agent's capability for data-driven petty optimization.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer reviewed the timeout numbers and buffer percentages provided in the PR body before approving.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes max/avg runtimes and buffer calculations, but no raw data or scripts to regenerate the analysis.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Devin investigated a flaky e2e test failure and confirmed it was unrelated to the timeout changes.

core_change_summary.description: Reduced timeout_minutes in GitHub Actions workflows (playwright.yml and test_cli.yaml) based on analysis of recent run durations, and added comments with avg/max run times.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: set timeout values (playwright 16→13 min, test_cli build_wheel 10→3, test_cli 15→10, test_examples 15→3).
Second commit: update timeout comments to include avg/max times with date stamp.

review_signals.summary: Explained that a failed test (streams.spec.ts) is unrelated to timeout changes and is a pre-existing flaky test.
Vercel bot posted deployment preview metadata.

Devin commented with CI failure investigation (unrelated flaky test).
